digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 24 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 11 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Autonomous Robots: An Explainable AI-Based Decision Framework
papers.abstract: Autonomous robots powered by deep learning face a fundamental auditability challenge: when incidents occur, investigators cannot reconstruct why the system made specific decisions. This paper presents
papers.summary_zh: 提出可解释决策框架TRACE，通过透明推理架构重构深度学习决策链，使事故归因可追溯，在保证任务成功率的同时将决策可解释性提升至92%

papers.title: Post-Training Language Models for Gold-Medal Performance in Coding Competitions

papers.title: UE5M3 FP4 Block Scaling for Stable Language Model Pretraining

papers.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
